They are bound together by their shared devotion to the Machine Cult. Friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models have the following ability: Assisted Targeting (Aura): While a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is within 6" of this model, that ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit’s ranged attacks have: ▪ +1 BS. ▪ [HEAVY]. If you do, that model heals D3 wounds. Mechanicus Allies: You can include TECH‑PRIEST DOMINUS/ TECH‑PRIEST MANIPULUS/MARSHAL/RANGERS/VANGUARD units in your army (see Codex: Adeptus Mechanicus). The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points. ENHANCEMENTS MAGOS QUESTORIS An expert in the intricate mechanisms and weapons systems of Imperial Knights, this Tech‑Priest taught Sacristans their craft. They now walk in the shadow of these war machines and make field repairs in the midst of battle. TECH‑PRIEST model only. When using this model’s Sacristan Pledge ability, the selected IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model heals 2 additional wounds. KNIGHT OF THE OPUS MACHINA (AURA) A devotee of the Omnissian creed, this Noble is inspired by the presence of the Adeptus Mechanicus, fighting with greater zeal and vigour in their holy presence. IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is within 6" of this model, that ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit’s melee attacks have +1 WS and AP. THE CLADES OF THE ADEPTUS MECHANICUS

FAQS Q: Can Adeptus Mechanicus units use the Doctrina Imperatives ability when taken as part of the Questor Forgepact Detachment? A: No.

Full Tilt.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army.
Full Tilt.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, or 9" instead if your unit is an Armiger or Destrier unit.

Noble Sacrifice.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
Noble Sacrifice.effect: Your unit’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+, adding 1 to the result if it is an Armiger unit, instead of only a 6.

Point‑blank Barrage.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Point‑blank Barrage.effect: Until the end of the phase, when making ranged attacks with Blast weapons, models in your unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of your unit (provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit). In addition, until the end of the phase, your unit does not suffer the penalty to its Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, but each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Blast weapon that targets a unit within Engagement Range of your unit, on an unmodified Hit roll of 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.

Strength From Exile.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Strength From Exile.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your 1CP army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Strength From Exile.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other friendly units within 9" of your unit, re‑roll a Hit roll of 1 and re‑roll a Wound roll of 1.

Survivor of Strife.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Survivor of Strife.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Survivor of Strife.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

In the Shadow of Giants.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is selected to make an advance/fall‑back move.
In the Shadow of Giants.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action. This detachment has the ARMIGERS tag and cannot be taken with another ARMIGERS detachment. Omnissiah’s Grace.when: Any phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit suffers a mortal wound.
Omnissiah’s Grace.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Vengeance of the Machine Cult.when: Any phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
Vengeance of the Machine Cult.effect: That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle: ▪ While a unit is marked, friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units’ attacks that target that unit can re‑roll wound rolls.

Courageous Stand.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Courageous Stand.target: One **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Courageous Stand.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.
Courageous Stand.lore: When the night is long and the unworthy claw at one’s shield, it is chivalry and duty that buoy the soul and bolster failing strength.

Driven By The Past.target: One **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC** unit from your army.
Driven By The Past.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Driven By The Past.lore: To the worthiest Noble, the whispers that reach their mind from a Throne Mechanicum appear as a tapestry of virtues, standards they strive to meet with wholehearted alacrity.

Hero’s Tread.target: One **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC** model from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
Hero’s Tread.effect: Your Level of Control over that objective marker is 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
Hero’s Tread.lore: It is said that unalloyed heroism can purge the foulest dishonour, that the very footsteps of those of noblest purity are enough to sanctify their path.

Titanic Duel.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Titanic Duel.target: One **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC** model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Titanic Duel.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack that targets a **MONSTER**, **TITANIC** or **WALKER** unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
Titanic Duel.lore: The greatest Knightly champions suffer no dishonourable rival to insult them for long with their existence.

Unstoppable Warrior.when: Your Movement phase, just after an **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC** unit from your army Falls Back.
Unstoppable Warrior.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Unstoppable Warrior.lore: Death is a distant priority when heroism’s favour awaits. A breath to seize a new perspective, a new angle at which to tilt towards the foe, permits only a brief reprieve for the enemy of a true warrior.

Exemplar’s Wisdom.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC** model from your army has shot.
Exemplar’s Wisdom.target: That **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC** model, and one or more friendly **ARMIGER** models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
Exemplar’s Wisdom.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your **ARMIGER** models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Exemplar’s Wisdom.lore: With a fusillade upon their chosen enemy, the Bondsmen’s mentor lectures their loyal servants on the application of force to the foe’s weak points.

Let Duty Be Your Shield.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Let Duty Be Your Shield.target: One **ARMIGER** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking units attacks.
Let Duty Be Your Shield.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Let Duty Be Your Shield.lore: Heeding the teachings of their Noble master, a Bondsman is reminded that only by enduring can they hope to discharge their sworn obligations.

Mantle of the Mentor.target: One **ARMIGER** model from your army, or one **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC** model from your army, and one or more friendly **ARMIGER** models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
Mantle of the Mentor.effect: Until the end of the phase, your **ARMIGER** models are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Fell Back.
Mantle of the Mentor.lore: With a rapid volley of covering fire from a Noble liege, Bondsmen employ hit‑and‑run tactics at high speed.

Thin Their Ranks.target: One **ARMIGER** model from your army, or one **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC** model from your army, and one or more friendly **ARMIGER** models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
Thin Their Ranks.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your **ARMIGER** models have the **[RAPID FIRE 1]** ability.
Thin Their Ranks.lore: A stentorian firing solution floods their Helms Mechanicum, and eager young Nobles shred their master’s foes in a blizzard of fury.

Virtue of Courage.target: One **ARMIGER** model from your army, or one **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC** model from your army, and one or more friendly **ARMIGER** models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
Virtue of Courage.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your **ARMIGER** models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
Virtue of Courage.lore: A Knight must have the courage to face the greatest horrors of the galaxy, with duty focusing their blows.

Helm Conditioning.when: Your Command phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit uses a Bondsman ability.
Helm Conditioning.effect: When selecting an ARMIGER model for that Bondsman ability, you can select one within 18" of your unit (excluding models already affected by a Bondsman ability).

ENHANCEMENTS  MYSTERIOUS GUARDIAN Manifesting as though from nowhere, this Knight is an elemental force of vengeance against the Emperor of Mankind’s foes. At battle’s end, it disappears as mysteriously as it arrived. Imperial Knights model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is unengaged, you can use this ability. If you do: ■ Place this unit in strategic reserves. ■ This unit has Deep Strike until the start of your next Shooting phase. ■ This unit must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn). SANCTUARY Through the projection of rapidly modulating ion fields, this unique generator’s effects wreathe the suit in an all encompassing fog of protective energies that defend it from close‑quarters attacks. Imperial Knights model only. The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save. BRINGER OF JUSTICE It is said that whenever this famed weapon is brought to life, it shall not fall silent until it has slaked its thirst for justice. Imperial Knights model only. Improve the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 2, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. HUNTER’S EYE This remarkable data‑manifold surrounds a scion with holo‑projected bioscans and engine‑signature readouts, whose gaze penetrates the densest terrain as though it was not there. Imperial Knights model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

Neural Lash.target: One friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
Neural Lash.effect: Select one friendly battle‑shocked ARMIGER unit within 12" of your unit. That ARMIGER unit is no longer battle‑shocked.

Rotate Ion Shields.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Rotate Ion Shields.target: One **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Rotate Ion Shields.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Rotate Ion Shields.lore: Veteran Knight pilots can swiftly re‑angle their ion shields and manipulate their energies to deflect incoming firepower.

Run Them Through!.target: One **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Run Them Through!.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by your models have the **[LANCE]** ability.
Run Them Through!.lore: With deafening challenges blaring from their emitters, honour‑bound comrades slam into their foes, where the Nobles’ martial prowess and their Knight suits’ overwhelming power are wedded to overcome the most monstrous resilience.

Thunderstomp.target: One **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** model from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Thunderstomp.effect: Until the end of the phase, the Attacks characteristic of any armoured Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 8, the Attacks characteristic of any titanic Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 12, and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.
Thunderstomp.lore: The Noble brings their Knight suit’s weight down with the force of an industrial piledriver, trampling their honourless foes beneath their iron tread.

Vow of Retribution.target: One **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Vow of Retribution.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your models have the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.
Vow of Retribution.lore: With the swearing of cooperative pacts, Knightly companions vow to visit annihilation on their enemies in a searing barrage of retributive firepower.
